responsibility: This module implements GCC’s RTL-in-SSA infrastructure: a function-level representation of RTL after CFG formation that recasts register and memory effects, phi merging, and instruction dependencies into SSA-style objects so later RTL analyses and transformations can reason about values, clobbers, and legal motion precisely. Its main file groups define the core access/resource model for defs, uses, sets, clobbers, and definition lookup; build basic-block and extended-basic-block metadata from the CFG; represent instructions, notes, ordering, and call-clobber information; and own whole-function state that constructs and simplifies the RTL SSA form. Surrounding support code provides private construction-time data structures, predicates for querying SSA while ignoring selected instructions or pending edits, legality checks and range restrictions for moving instructions within EBBs, and the machinery for proposing, validating, costing, recognizing, and applying instruction changes while repairing affected CFG and jump metadata. Overall, this module is the RTL-side SSA substrate used to support safe low-level optimization and transformation, distinct from GIMPLE/tree SSA and from target-specific emission code.
